email.subject: Clearwater Plumbing's site is losing calls
email.body:
Hi Maria,

I looked at Clearwater Plumbing's website. Two things are likely costing you jobs: there's no hours of operation listed anywhere, so someone with a burst pipe at 9pm can't tell if you'll pick up, and the page title doesn't mention plumbing or Harbor Falls, which hurts your Google search ranking against competitors who do. The homepage also loads slowly from oversized images, which pushes mobile visitors away before they see your number.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you the specific issues on your site? No pitch, just the findings.

Alex
